_comment: Zene egg for Pelican Panel (compatible with Pterodactyl PTDL_v2)
name: Zene
author: lunedusk
description: Zene Discord framework (Node 20+, pure ESM). Clones a git repo, installs deps, builds when src/ is present, starts with node --import ./core/dependency/index.mjs when available.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ -n "${NODE_PACKAGES}" ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}; fi; if [[ -n "${UNNODE_PACKAGES}" ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm uninstall ${UNNODE_PACKAGES}; fi; if [ -f /home/container/package.json ]; then /usr/local/bin/npm install; if [ -d /home/container/src ]; then /usr/local/bin/npm run build; fi; fi; if [[ -f /home/container/core/dependency/index.mjs ]]; then /usr/local/bin/node --import ./core/dependency/index.mjs "/home/container/${MAIN_FILE}" ${NODE_ARGS}; elif [[ "${MAIN_FILE}" == *.ts ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npx --yes tsx "/home/container/${MAIN_FILE}" ${NODE_ARGS}; else /usr/local/bin/node "/home/container/${MAIN_FILE}" ${NODE_ARGS}; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 python3-dev python3-pip libtool
npm install npm@latest --location=global
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-}" = "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-}" = "1" ]; then echo user_upload; exit 0; fi
if [[ "${GIT_ADDRESS}" != *.git ]]; then GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"; fi
if [ -z "${USERNAME:-}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  git clone --branch "${GIT_BRANCH:-main}" --single-branch "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
else
  git clone --branch "${GIT_BRANCH:-main}" --single-branch "https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@${GIT_ADDRESS#https://}" .
fi
if [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; if [ -d src ]; then npm run build || true; fi; fi
echo Zene install complete

variables.description: Git HTTPS URL for the Zene repository.
